When your ideology has you worrying about hurting a murderer’s feelings instead of stating the facts, it’s time to rethink it.


Matt Lamb (@MattLamb22)

.@PhoenixLoyola : We are very sorry we referred to the suspected murderer of one of our peers as an 'illegal immigrant.'





— https://nitter.net/MattLamb22/status/2036819218398667059#m

You don’t have to like our options but you have to accept them. Because accepting reality is part of being an adult in a dangerous world. The President gets this. Many Democrats actually get it too, but their TDS brain seizures makes them reactively stupid. And the “MAGA” detractors led by traitor-in-chief Tucker Carlson? They never miss a chance to defend our enemies and give China space to grow all while chanting “America First” and yelling something about the Jews. 

Stop the pearl clutching

So what’s the better option? Allow them to become a larger threat and more hardened target? Wait until they get a nuke and become untouchable, free to wreak havoc without fear of retaliation, like North Korea?

You want another North Korea?

And capabilities? Well they were rebuilding their destroyed nuclear sites, for one thing. Commercial imagery can even see that. And they were producing hundreds of new missiles and drones per day, quickly reaching a point where our counter-measures would be overwhelmed. 

That’s capability and intent.

In the case of Iran, just because we don’t have a tweet from the IRGC talking about striking on a certain day doesn’t mean we don’t have capability and intent.

Do they intend to attack America and our allies? Yeah, they’ve been chanting it for decades. They build missiles with increasing ranges. They build enrichment facilities deep under ground and enrich beyond commercial needs. So that part is clear.

First of all, it’s extremely rare for intelligence to be so accurate and well-vetted that we can say for sure a “threat is imminent.” The word imminent is inherently subjective. A truly imminent threat is a missile that was just fired. Everything before that moment is a mixture of factors: capability, intent, analysis of enemy risk tolerance, etc. A huge number of factors contribute to the idea of “imminence.”

For all the pearl-clutching from the media and the Democrats trying to poke holes in the notion of “imminent threat” posed by Iran: Let’s have a quick lesson on intelligence analysis, geopolitics, and common sense. 

THREAD.

Chuck Norris led an extraordinary life. Air Force veteran. World champion martial artist. Legendary actor. A devout Christian. 
 
He’s a true American icon whose strength, discipline, and faith inspired generations. Perhaps his greatest legacy was bringing joy to so many through laughter. Chuck Norris jokes will never go out of style. 

Chuck Norris actually died in 2003, but Death just now got the courage to tell him. 

Rest in Peace Chuck.

Tucker likes to have friendly conversations with bad people. When he realizes that he’s talking to Iranian intelligence officials that we already collect on, he pretends to be a victim of “spying.” He’s an idiot, and he thinks you’re an idiot too. 

You always need a warrant to “wire tap” any American citizen. Full stop.

But if you’re communicating with a criminal and that criminal’s phone is tapped (because a judge authorized it), then your conversation is now part of that investigation. If th

Two years ago, Congress almost left the county with a huge intelligence gap for no good reason. Lives would have been lost had we not reauthorozed FISA. The violent cartel leader “El Mencho” would still be alive if we had not reauthorized FISA and passed my provision to target cartel affiliates for collection.

You’d be amazed by how many Republicans voted to PROTECT cartels from intelligence collection. Exactly 83 Republicans voted against my bill to add cartels to FISA collection.

Too many people are turning against the President because they are scared of the idea of using strength to enable a long term peace.

I know which one I’m sticking with.
